settings.title: What visitors ask about outdoor equipment rentals

tabs.tab_title: Do I need special shoes for The Narrows?
tabs.tab_content: Water, uneven rocks and temperatures affect equipment choice. Read NPS Narrows safety information before selecting rental gear.

tabs.tab_title: Are e-bikes permitted everywhere in Zion?
tabs.tab_content: No blanket permission should be assumed. Consult park biking rules and where the bicycle class is permitted.

tabs.tab_title: Can a rental shop lead a guided hike?
tabs.tab_content: Only where the service and route are appropriately authorized. Equipment rental and commercial guiding have distinct requirements.
